issues.recoverable_primary_claim: Dudek–Grenie–Molteni1503.05403v2PDFp2 displays the exact Perron integrand and psi1=x^2/2-sumx^(rho+1)/[rho(rho+1)]-xr+rprime+R1, together with a remainder-size bound.
issues.old_flawed_fragment: The exact b(t)=-log(1-t^-2)/2 was used without displaying the residue recovery of r and R1 from that bounded primitive.
issues.trigger_and_impact: A size bound such as.6/x does not imply a derivative formula (e.g..6sin(x^3)/x satisfies that size bound while its derivative need not be small). This is a missing written derivation, not an incorrect numerical allowance or an error in the paper. Uniform convergence of the primitive zero series alone likewise does not license termwise differentiation.
issues.repair: BOX_PNT_PROOF now derives the zeta0 values by the functional equation, the exact trivial-zero residues, uniform geometric R1/R1prime convergence on x>=a>1, then integrates psi1 by parts before interchanging only boundary/integral terms of its absolutely uniformly convergent zero series. Individual zero terms become the exact averaged packet; endpoint values, rprime cancellation, -log2pi*unitmass and the R1prime trivial term are explicit. No full zero-series termwise derivative is used.
